method: pdftotext scan of local OGE filing PDFs for reviewer fee annotations; annotations are OGE reviewing officials' notes on the certification/comments page. Scanned the 43 deduplicated whole-filing PDFs in data/pdfs/ (page-chunk .pagesN-N.pdf files for the 5 large Trump filings were skipped as duplicates of content already present in the corresponding whole PDF). Searched full extracted text (all pages) for: 'late fee', 'late filing fee', 'paid late', 'filer paid', OCR-fuzzy variants ('lale fee', 'late foe', 'lato fee'), plus 'civil penalty', 'fee assessed', 'fee paid', '$200 fee', 'late payment', 'penalty assessed', 'waived'/'waiver', and manually reviewed every 'Comments of Reviewing Official(s)' / 'OGE Received' block found anywhere in the corpus. Records carry an 'outcome' field: 'paid' (fee payment noted) or 'waived' (reviewer noted a waiver).

payments.annotationRaw: (05/21/2026, Bartek-Santiago, Alice): Late filing fee was waived due to filer's accidental error in omitting this transaction from a previous timely filed report.

payments.note: This is a fee annotation but explicitly states the fee was waived, not paid or assessed. Excluded from the payments array per the task's payment/assessed-only criterion; included here for visibility since it is a real reviewer fee annotation.

counts.note: 43 deduplicated whole-filing PDFs scanned (out of 164 total .pdf files in data/pdfs/; the other 121 are page-chunk copies of 5 of these 43 filings — all Trump filings — and were not scanned separately to avoid double-counting).
